g.text: t<NR> := SRV (shader resource view) - read-only buffer/texture
u<NR> := UAV (unordered access view) - read-write buffer/texture
b<NR> := CBV (constant buffer view) - small constant-buffer data
From the dispatch definitions (not inferred): dispatch order, entry nodes, entry-record values, defines. Everything else is read from the DXIL.
= node reads the UAV · dotted grey = declared but never launched (0 records allocated)
Solid arrows = work-graph records inside one dispatch; resource access is read from the compiled DXIL
Red border = the dispatch's entrypoint · dashed border = grid can expand to >1 group
